messages:
Maria Nunez: Heads up — egress firewall tightening rolled to eu-west an hour ago. We're seeing audit-log buffering spike and the GPU warmpool failed to prewarm for multiple node joins (stuck in provisioning). Noticed S3 put throttle errors in the logshipper. @Ajay can you take a look?
Ajay Patel: On it. I see a bunch of 503s coming from our log-collector -> s3 proxy, plus conntrack counts high on the natgw. Firewall change added a default deny for outbound to the audit shipper cluster, but we allowed the collector LB; looks like the proxy is on a different ENI.
Devon Chen: Confirmed from the runtime side: 8 join attempts in the last 15m that timed out waiting for audit ack. Warmpool eviction kicked in after 2m and we fell back to slow cold starts. Latency up ~120ms p50 for first tokens on warmups.
Maria Nunez: Ugh. Cost hit already — a lot of failed prewarm retries. @Ethan how bad is this if it continues for a day?
Ethan Cole: If we lose warmpool efficiency in eu-west for 24h we're looking at ~18% extra GPU hours and about a 22% bump in token cost for affected routes (guestimate). Also storage egress from retries to S3 could add a few hundred USD.
Lucy Park: Security note: the firewall change was to clamp an overly-broad egress allowlist. We intentionally tightened the /22 to deny unknown outbound. If we open an exception for the proxy ENI we should capture it in the audit allowlist and add a short-lived justification.
Ajay Patel: I'm going to add a temporary egress allow rule for the log-proxy ENI (eni-0a1b2c3d) and whitelabel the S3 proxy CIDR for 1h. That should let the backlog drain. Will also bump conntrack on natgw as emergency.
Devon Chen: Please also flip the warmpool back to lenient prewarm timeout for eu-west until logs are flowing. Current setting is 10s, raise to 60s. That prevents premature eviction.
sre-bot: [alert] eu-west: warmpool prewarm failures increased by 9x since firewall rollout. Triggered runbook #wg-boot-02.
Ajay Patel: Quick commands I'm running:
```
# temporary firewall rule
aws ec2 authorize-security-group-ingress --group-id sg-auditshipper --protocol tcp --port 443 --cidr 10.12.34.0/24 --description "temp allow log-proxy eni"
# bump conntrack
aws ec2 modify-network-interface-attribute --network-interface-id eni-0a1b2c3d --attachment "{\"AttachmentId\":\"att-xxxxx\",\"DeleteOnTermination\":false}"
```
Maria Nunez: Thanks. After Ajay's change, logs are trickling again but there's a backlog. How do we avoid this class of failure?
Lucy Park: We should adopt a dependency manifest for audit endpoints per-region and gate firewall rollouts with an e2e check that validates logshipper -> s3 and log-proxy health. If rollout fails the check, rollback automatically.
Devon Chen: Idea: add a short test during CD that posts a small test-event to the audit stream and waits for S3 object to appear (signed URL) within 30s. If it misses, mark the deploy as failed. That would have caught this.
Ethan Cole: Agreed. Also for cost control: make the warmpool degrade path smarter — prefer staying with slightly reduced capacity rather than hundreds of cold starts and retries. We can set a budgeted fallback ramp.
Maria Nunez: For now, Ajay / Devon — coordinate to keep the temp allow open for 45m while backlog drains and then close it. After that we should run a controlled rollback of the firewall change and re-roll with the dependency manifest.
Ajay Patel: Will coordinate. Pushing rule now. I'll post when conntrack bump finishes.
Devon Chen: Pushed the lenient prewarm timeout. Observability: adding a per-region metric for audit-ack latency so we can alert before warmpool eviction threshold.
sre-bot: [info] Firewall rule added: sg-auditshipper -> allow 10.12.34.0/24:443 (temporary).
deploy-bot: Rollout event: egress-tighten-v2 -> eu-west (partial) FAILED health-check. Automatic pause engaged.
Maria Nunez: Good catch by deploy-bot pause. Next actions: 1) let backlog drain (Ajay) 2) revert firewall change in eu-west and re-run with manifest + e2e check (Lucy to lead) 3) tune warmpool fallback (Devon) 4) estimate cost impact and notify finance (Ethan).
Ethan Cole: I'll draft a short cost note once we have exact numbers from the warmpool metrics.
Lucy Park: I'll own the rollout plan rework and add the audit manifest to the playbook. Will schedule a quick retro.
Ajay Patel: Backlog draining, errors down to single digits. I'll prod for rollback in 30m unless we see a regression.
Maria Nunez: Thanks all. Please @channel update once firewall is fully rolled back. :thumbsup:
